question: Which of the following is an autobiography of the Indian boxer, Mary Kom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unbreakable: An Autobiography.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unbreakable: An Autobiography** is the autobiography of the unbreakable Mary Kom who never let anything come between her and her quest for winning.
 
• She worked hard and showed the world that with mere hard work and utmost dedication it is possible for even a** farmer's daughter** to become the world's leading woman boxer.
 
• At a glittering event at **Bangalore's Forum Mall,** Mary Kom launched her much-awaited autobiography, **Unbreakable**.
 
• Published by Harper Collins, the book chronicles Mary's **relentless struggle** and** an unflinching passion for boxing.**
 
• **"My story is the same as that of thousands of women in this country",** she said**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Autobiography of Mike Tyson (Tyson is considered to be one of the greatest heavyweight boxers of all time) is Undisputed Truth: My autobiography.
 
• **Playing It My Way** is the autobiography of former Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar.
 
• The book “The Test of My Life: From Cricket to Cancer and Back” is an autobiography of Yuvraj Singh.
